en.title: Constitutional Acts, 1773 to 1947
en.subtitle: How British rule built the frame India later used

items.what: Governor of Bengal made Governor-General; Supreme Court at Calcutta
Board of Control in London over Company affairs
Company's trade monopoly ended, except tea and trade with China; money for education
Governor-General of India; Company becomes purely administrative
Open competition for civil services; separate legislative council
Crown rule; Secretary of State for India
Indians nominated to councils; portfolio system
Indirect election to councils; budget discussion
Morley-Minto: separate electorates for Muslims
Dyarchy in provinces; two Houses at the centre
Provincial autonomy; proposed federation; Federal Court; three lists
Two dominions; British rule ends

blocks.text: Much of the 1935 Act, including the three lists and emergency powers, carried into the Constitution of India.

remember: 1935 Act is the Constitution's biggest source
